name: 5-mods
description: Claude Code mods by INEMA.CLUB: cache savings, recording mode, a /goal progress bar, a guard for parallel chats, and next-step suggestions

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps a big chat's prompt cache warm, warns before an expensive cold restart, shows every local chat on one board (/board), and hands a chat off to a fresh one (/handoff)

plugins.name: recording-mode
plugins.description: /rec before you record: masks keys, personal details, and business figures on screen and keeps private files closed (/rec strict, /rec off, /rec config)

plugins.name: goal-meter
plugins.description: A progress bar for /goal built from Claude's own task plan: tasks done out of the plan, elapsed time, an ETA at the goal's own pace, and every chat's goal in /goals

plugins.name: collision-guard
plugins.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another open chat changed in the last 30 minutes: Proceed, Move to a worktree, or Cancel (/guard)

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: After each turn, up to three suggested next prompts as buttons above the prompt: press one to send it, or dismiss (/next on|off)
